phrases.text: What is the weather like outside?

translations.pt: Como está o tempo lá fora?
translations.en: What is the weather like outside?

phrases.text: It is raining, take your umbrella.

translations.de: Es regnet, nimm deinen Regenschirm mit.
translations.en: It is raining, take your umbrella.

phrases.text: I love the warm summer season.

translations.es: Amo la cálida estación del verano.
translations.pt: Eu amo a estação quente do verão.
translations.en: I love the warm summer season.

phrases.text: It is freezing cold this winter.

translations.es: Hace un frío helado este invierno.
translations.pt: Está um frio congelante neste inverno.
translations.fr: Il fait un froid glacial cet hiver.
translations.de: Es ist eiskalt in diesem Winter.
translations.it: Fa un freddo gelido questo inverno.
translations.en: It is freezing cold this winter.

phrases.text: The wind is blowing very hard.

translations.es: El viento está soplando muy fuerte.
translations.pt: O vento está soprando muito forte.
translations.en: The wind is blowing very hard.

phrases.text: The autumn leaves are falling down.

translations.es: Las hojas de otoño están cayendo.
translations.pt: As folhas de outono estão caindo.
translations.en: The autumn leaves are falling down.

phrases.text: It will be sunny and hot tomorrow.

translations.fr: Il fera beau et chaud demain.
translations.de: Morgen wird es sonnig und heiß sein.
translations.en: It will be sunny and hot tomorrow.
